versions.changelog:
Initial release: Real-time DX cluster monitoring and personalized alerts for ham radio operators.

- Monitor global DX clusters for live and rare station spots.
- Track active DX expeditions and get daily band activity digests.
- Automated email/SMS alerts and digest summaries with cron support.
- Use AI-enhanced mode for propagation prediction and DXCC filtering.
- Personalized scoring and high-priority alerts based on your station/QTH.
- Includes common band plans, rare prefix lists, and prompt examples for Clawdbot.
